_doc: Hand-curated prompt inputs for tools/illustrate.py. Per character: identity (constant fill-in cues shared by every range), setting (replaces the wuxia murim phrase for non-murim characters), framing, eyes/expression with their Korean basis (null basis = fill-in), fill_ins (hair, clothing, motif: not stated in the novel), and per-range overrides keyed by range start. Range text may use only that range's profile line plus non-spoiler basics. Characters without an entry are uncurated and blocked from generation by default.
